analysis.title: AI Adoption: From Investment to Results (Market Insight)
key_insights: Alger splits the AI opportunity into enablers (chips, data centers, cloud, software tools) that have captured most gains so far, and adopters that put AI to work in products or operations. It believes a growing share of the opportunity may belong to adopters.

Alger defines successful AI adoption as reaching the income statement, either as faster revenue growth from better products or as margin expansion from better operations. Both lead to stronger earnings growth.

Many companies describe AI benefits anecdotally because time savings do not reach the income statement unless they change headcount needs or sales. Alger expects more companies to report quantified results as models improve.

Axon Enterprise: the AI Era Plan took roughly $750M of orders in its first full year, about one-tenth of 2025 sales. AI ARR passed $100M by Q3 2026, AI orders rose over 50% in the first nine months, and existing customers spent 26% more than a year earlier.

Shopify: AI-assistant-driven orders rose 3.3x year over year in Q3 2026. Shoppers arriving via AI assistants converted 64% more often, and management said the economics are the same as other orders. Sidekick daily active merchants rose 3.7x.

Unity Software: Vector AI ad engine revenue grew 126% year over year in Q3 2026, with about 90% of growth from existing advertisers. Daily game-building users rose 25% after Unity opened its software to AI coding agents in August 2026.
Robinhood: AI resolves more than 75% of customer support cases. Revenue per employee rose from about $850K in 2023 to nearly $2M, reported on the October 2026 earnings call.

Rocket Companies: it originated nearly $50B of loans in Q4 2025 with half the head count versus early 2022. Management says 50% to 70% of additional revenue flows to EBITDA once fixed costs are covered.
Amazon: more than one million warehouse robots. Q1 2026 items sold grew 15% versus fulfillment expense growth of 11%. Six engineers built a cloud engine in 76 days using Amazon's AI coding tool.

Alger frames company-disclosed metrics such as subscription revenue, hours saved and revenue per employee as leading indicators that appear before earnings, which is where its active research focuses.
The document is a marketing brochure from an active manager, with no price targets, ratings or trade recommendations. Disclosures list firm-wide holdings in the featured names.

market_movers.rationale: AI Era Plan took about $750M of orders in year one and AI ARR passed $100M by Q3 2026. Presented as an example, not a rating.
AI-driven orders rose 3.3x year over year in Q3 2026 and AI-referred shoppers converted 64% more often.
Vector revenue grew 126% year over year in Q3 2026, with about 90% of growth from existing advertisers.
AI resolves over 75% of support cases and revenue per employee is near $2M versus about $850K in 2023.
Loan volume per production team member is 2x early 2022 levels, with 50% to 70% incremental EBITDA flow-through.
Q1 2026 items sold grew 15% versus fulfillment expense up 11%, aided by AI forecasting and over one million robots.

sector_views.rationale: Alger believes a growing share of the AI opportunity may belong to adopters that show AI results in revenue growth or margins.
Enablers have captured most of the opportunity so far, and the share is expected to shift toward adopters.

earnings_insights: Axon: AI Era Plan orders of roughly $750M in the first full year, about one-tenth of 2025 sales. AI ARR above $100M by Q3 2026, all company-reported.
Shopify Q3 2026, company-reported: AI-driven orders up 3.3x year over year and AI-referred shopper conversion 64% higher.
Unity Q3 2026, company-reported: Vector revenue up 126% year over year. Unity's November 2026 call cited a 25% rise in daily game-building users.
Robinhood, reported on the October 2026 call: revenue per employee near $2M, up from about $850K in 2023.
Rocket Q4 2025, company-reported: nearly $50B of originations. Management cites 50% to 70% incremental revenue flow-through to EBITDA.
Amazon Q1 2026, company-reported: items sold up 15% versus fulfillment expense up 11%.
risk_factors: AI-exposed companies may face intense competition, rapid product obsolescence and reliance on growing their consumer base.
Companies using AI could face reputational harm, legal liability and errors from inaccurate or biased AI outputs.
Growth stocks and smaller AI companies tend to be more volatile than other stocks.
Many companies cannot quantify AI's contribution to revenue or margins, so benefits may not reach the income statement.
charts_described: Figure 1 is a flow diagram of how AI adoption reaches the income statement. External product enhancement leads to revenue growth and internal productivity leads to margin expansion, and both lead to earnings growth.
